entities.summary: Natálie Mlýnková is a Czech professional ice hockey player for the Montreal Victoire of the Professional Women's Hockey League (PWHL), and a member of the Czech Republic women's national ice hockey team. She played college ice hockey at Vermont and Minnesota.
